senses.gloss:
रिक्त रिक्त, रिक्थ, &c. See below and
p. 846, col. 1.

रिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, emptied, cleared, purged;
empty, void; unloaded, unburdened; hollow, hol-
lowed (as the hands); having nothing, poor, indi-
gent; vain, worthless, valueless; epithet of one of
the four wagtails (employed in augury); free from,
devoid of, deprived of, destitute of, without; (आ), f.,
scil. तिथि, epithet of the fourth, ninth, or fourteenth
days of the lunar fortnight; (अम्), n. an empty
[]
place, empty space, vacuum, void, vacuity; a desert,
wilderness, wood, forest.
—रिक्त-कुम्भ, अम्, n.,
Ved. (the sound of) an empty vessel, a hollow
sound, empty or senseless language.
—रिक्त-कृत्,
त्, त्, त्, Ved. making empty, emptying; causing a
vacuum.
—रिक्त-गुरु, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 42.
—रिक्त-
ता, f. emptiness, vacuity, void, empty space or space
in general.
—रिक्त-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, empty-handed,
bringing no present.
—रिक्त-भाण्ड, अम्, n. an
empty vessel; (अस्, आ, अम्), having no vessels or
effects.
—रिक्त-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, empty-minded,
thinking of nothing
—रिक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
empty-handed, having empty hands, bringing no
present; carrying away no present.
—रिक्तार्क (˚त-
अर्˚), अस्, m. a Sunday falling on one of the Riktā
days.
—रिक्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make
empty or void, remove, take away; to steal; to
get back, recover.
—रिक्तीकृत-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्,
emptied or deprived of heart.

रिक्वन् रिक्वन्, आ, m., Ved. = स्तेन, a thief
(according to Naigh. III. 24).

रिक्षा रिक्षा, f. a nit (= लिक्षा); a mote
in a sun-beam.
रिक (?), अम्, n. the heart, mind; law, litigation.

रिक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, empty, void; unladen, un-
burdened.

रिक्थ, अम्, n. (frequently written ऋक्थ), pro-
perty left at death, inheritance, portion, bequest;
property in general, possessions, substance, wealth;
gold.
—रिक्थ-ग्राह, अस्, आ, अम्, receiving an in-
heritance, inheriting property; (अस्), m. an inheritor,
heir.
—रिक्थ-जात, अम्, n. the aggregate of a
property, collected estate (of a deceased person).
—रिक्थ-भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or रिक्थ-भाज्, क्, क्,
क्, inheriting or sharing property, dividing the pro-
perty (of a deceased person), an inheritor, heir.
—रिक्थ-विभाग, अस्, m. the division or sharing
of (a deceased person's) property, partition of inherit-
ance; a share in an inheritance.
—रिक्थ-हर or
रिक्थ-हार, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, receiving an inherit-
ance, inheriting property; (अस्), m. an heir.
—रिक्-
थ-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, receiving or inheriting pro-
perty; (ई), m. an heir, one who succeeds to property;
a maternal uncle; the seed of the Indian fig-tree.

रिक्थाद (˚थ-आद), अस्, आ, अम्, receiving an
inheritance; (अस्), m. an heir, son.

रिक्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inheriting property; possessing
property, wealthy; (ई), m. an heir.

रिक्थीय in अ-रिक्थीय, अस्, आ, अम्, incapable of
inheriting property, having no claim to inheritance.
